data.name: Imp Minion
data.description: You gain an imp minion that will serve you for %1 minutes per day. You must cast a summon monster spell to summon your imp minion-this special casting of summon monster does not summon any other monsters when you cast it in this way, but you can choose your imp minion as a favorite summons.|TL*10
